defects.description: The following headers were left untranslated in English: '## Escalation Protocol', '### Escalation Reasons', '### Escalation Document', '### Escalation Resolution Paths'.
The term 'Subject' is translated as 'объект' instead of the required glossary equivalent 'Объект обсуждения'.
Gender mismatch: the feminine adjective 'непустая' is used with the masculine noun 'режим'.
